fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Leans in with your full weight, dealing 15 damage, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunning it for 1.4 seconds. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Chewed Cud
fusions.desc: Spits a lump of cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises +6% per affliction the target carries (max +30%).

fusions.name: Settle In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Without Hurry
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
